part = destination.with_name(destination.name + ".part")
    with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=timeout) as response, \
            part.open("wb") as handle:
evidence.reason: download() creates a deterministic sibling `.part` path and opens it with `wb`, with no lock or cache recheck visible in fetch_sums/fetch_image. Concurrent first fetches against an empty state directory can therefore share the same staging inode; one invocation can finish, verify, and replace/promote that inode while another still has it open for writing, so the later writer can modify the promoted base after verification. Atomic rename does not protect an already-open writer. This is a current TOCTOU/race defect, not merely a request to add a new protection scope.
